findings.issue: join_check component tested only 6 of 7 provider-related relationships. It checked pharmacy_claims.pharmacy_npi but omitted pharmacy_claims.prescriber_npi->providers.provider_npi, which the manifest shows also fails completely (0% match, 18,310 unmatched). Comprehensive assessment of joinability requires testing both linkages.
findings.suggested_change: Add 'pharmacy_claims.prescriber_npi->providers.provider_npi' to the join_check pairs parameter

findings.issue: The pharmacy provider linkage failure is critical (0% match rate on both pharmacy_npi and prescriber_npi, affecting 100% of 18,310 pharmacy records) but is presented only as a buried join_check result. Sponsor needs to understand this as a fundamental blocker for pharmacy provider analysis.
findings.suggested_change: Enhance write_report to include a caveat or summary highlighting the pharmacy provider linkage gap, or use high-priority artifact citations to surface the join_check failures

summary: Plan was comprehensive but missed one critical relationship test (prescriber_npi). The identified pharmacy provider linkage failure is the most significant data quality finding but lacks sufficient emphasis for sponsor awareness.
